label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-controlled param flows to host variable, which is used in openUrlByHostname(host) at line 45+ to construct URLs. Although resolveHost() is called and isNonPublicAddress() checks the resolved IP, this does not mitigate SSRF risks like DNS rebinding (hostname changes between resolve and fetch), IPv6 bypasses, or cloud metadata endpoints. The resolved sink value at the URL construction is attacker-controlled host parameter.

evidence.note: User param -> host variable -> resolveHost(host) -> isNonPublicAddress check -> openUrlByHostname(host) with unresolved user input
